finding.text: The task folder has no top-level `requirements.md`; the owner's ask for the Mention change ("anything referenceable is clickable, never only a code snippet") is stated only inside `ext/Mention/doc/Mention-notes.md`. A fresh agent cannot check the diff against the owner's words, so add a `requirements.md` (or `plan.md` section) that quotes it and links the prompt.

The diff touches only `ext/Mention/`, yet the folder holds three briefs (`reader/`, `roles/`, `routing/`). `roles/` has no report, proposal or `log` line in its folder, and `reader/` is only a design in `plan.md` with no link from `reader/requirements.md` to it, so what landed and what is open can't be read from the folder alone. Add a short `report.md` per brief, or an index in `plan.md`.

`ext/Mention/readme.md` (lines 4 and 21) still says only "a person or an agent role"; it never says that `@mastermind-x`/`task-mastermind-*`-shaped live agent ids now link, nor that a code span holding only a reference is upgraded. `doc/Mention-notes.md` was updated, but `doc/syntax.md` (the syntax rules) does not mention the code-span rule or the agent link, so it is now stale on "code is left alone".

`Mention.js:108` and `upgrade_code` accept any bare `assistant…` word: `AGENT_KIND` has `/^assistant/`, so inline code like `assistant` or `assistants` (and `minion-` prefixes in prose code) turns into a link to `/framework/ai/sessions/assistant/` that opens no agent. Only upgrade a bare (no `@`) code span when it matches a stricter id shape (for example `assistant-<name>`), or require the `@`.
`upgrade_code` (`Mention.js:216`) bypasses `skip()`, so a `code` inside a `textarea`, or any editable surface, would be rewritten too; harmless today, but the walk below it honours `SKIP_TAGS`.

`mention_html` (the string form) does not apply the code-span upgrade, so `mentions(el)` and `mention_html` now differ on `` `@owner` ``; say so in `Mention-notes.md` or it will surprise the next reader.

No test or screenshot covers the new behaviour; `shots/` holds only `framework-1920.png` and `framework-ext-Chat-v2-1920.png`, neither of which shows a code-span mention. A one-line check in the demo page would prove it.

Simpler path: the same effect could be had by dropping `CODE` from `SKIP_TAGS` only for whole-text matches, instead of a second pass over every `code` element, but the current pass is small and clear; leave it unless it shows up in profiles.

The task folder has no top-level `requirements.md`; the asks live only in `reader/`, `roles/`, `routing/` and the handoff, so a fresh agent cannot see the numbered asks from `plan.md` alone (it points at "the spawn prompt"). Add one `requirements.md` that lists asks 1-10 in the owner's words, or link them from `plan.md`.

The diff delivers only step 1 of A (the V2 model fixes, the tests, two docs), yet `plan.md` row A reads "review and merge" as if the reader work were finished. The ask was ONE shared reader for V1, V2 and the session page; step 2 was stopped by the size rule and the decision to keep V1 on its own shape is only in `reader/design.md`. Say in `plan.md` that the one-reader ask is deferred to E and that the owner's "one reader" was not met by this diff.

`ext/Chat/v2/readme.md:110` (diff) says 47 checks, but the diff adds three `check()` calls to `ChatV2.test.mjs` on a readme that said 43, which makes 46. Run the test and put in the real number, since the readme is meant to be verified.

`ChatV2.test.mjs` `check("paragraphs.replace…", true)` and `check("raw.push with an array…", true)` are always true after the `waitForFunction`. They fail only by timeout throwing, which is fine, but the failure then reads as a crash and not a failed check.

The new `core/Task/sentences.js` splitter also splits on newlines and on whitespace after `.!?…` where the old regex did not. A fixture reply anchored to an old id such as `a3` could now point at different words. The doc already lists "a rewrite renumbers sentences" (defect 6), but run the 43 existing checks (they were not shown) to confirm no fixture anchor moved.

`prompt-record.md:44-45` (diff context) still calls V1's `Widget.Thread` and defects 1, 2, 6, 7 open; that is accurate. The main-tree copy still shows the old "replace ignored" rows until this merges, so merge before anyone reads it.

The simpler path in `ChatV2Model.js:78-81` is fine: it drops one regex and adds an import. Nothing broken found in the `raw`, `paragraphs.add` and `paragraphs.replace` branches. The two new screenshots under `session-d3ed399d/minion-minion-chat-reader/shots/` were not inspected, and the minion's folder holds only `past-work.md` and `session.jsonl` (no readme or report), so link them from this task's `plan.md`.
